author: fester
body: A copied constant is the divergence this project has a chapter about, so it gets a runner rather than a promise: codex/test/apps/facts-partition boots a store on an image this writer produced and requires it to FIND its partition. Change one list and not the other and that test stops finding anything.

author: fester
body: The image carried ONE partition, the ESP, spanning everything from 2048 to the last usable LBA. A stick built that way has nowhere to put a fact: DiskFacts addresses inside a partition of its own type, finds none, and refuses -- which is correct and is also a stick that cannot remember anything.
